narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Next to five p come five p minus one and five p plus one.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try p as two. The middle house is then ten.
<bookmark mark='odd'/>Chintu's doors become nine and eleven, which are odd. They cannot be on the even side.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Stepping by one jumps off the even numbers.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows 5p − 2, 5p − 1, 5p, 5p + 1, 5p + 2; with p = 2 the doors read 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 9 and 11 flash in the warning colour; the bubble is struck

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, put in any even value of p and list the five numbers.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Each must be even and two more than the one before it.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the filled tags; the line put in a value of p and check every number is even appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu steps by one and writes five p minus two, five p minus one, five p plus one and five p plus two. With p as two, nine and eleven are odd, so they cannot sit on the even side.
